images.alt_text: Workspace evidence flows to two parallel model critics, a judge, targeted high-effort repair only when needed and a separate regression check that verifies improvement.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Two critics independently inspect the same workspace evidence, a judge decides whether repair is needed, high-effort review is isolated to the repair path and a separate preview check verifies improvement.

images.alt_text: Direct, transitive and reusable workflow references resolve from tags or branches into immutable commits recorded in actions.lock, then feed CI checks and reviewed update pull requests.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The dependency lattice visibly distinguishes direct, transitive and reusable references, resolves tags or branches to immutable commits, records them in the lockfile and separates deterministic CI from reviewed update proposals.

images.alt_text: Approved enterprise documents are chunked and embedded for semantic retrieval, passed through a supervisor to summary and presentation tools, then checked for headlines, numbers, citations, confidentiality and layout.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The source-to-deck provenance arc keeps approved documents, retrieval, cited passages, orchestration, slide creation and four independent human review gates visible while qualifying the design as a reference architecture.

images.alt_text: A document classifier routes new types through instruction generation and failed validation into instruction refinement, while known types reuse stored instructions and failed records return to data correction without changing guidance.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The figure-eight state machine distinguishes new and known document types. Only a failed new-type validation refines reusable instructions; a failed known-record validation fixes data without changing instructions, while both successful paths produce an audit record.

images.alt_text: A read-only Skill compares requested capabilities with the actual task across write access, repository scope, data exposure, external action, owner approval and token lifecycle, then returns PASS, REVIEW or STOP before human authorization.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The permission audit machine compares necessary read and excessive write test cases across six explicit governance columns. It ends at PASS, REVIEW or STOP and leaves installation closed until human authorization; the caption states that the Skill audits and does not install.

images.alt_text: A role-scoped helpdesk retrieves curated knowledge and resolved threads, permits screenshots only from the file host, answers supported questions, clarifies uncertainty and creates a validated ticket only after explicit confirmation, with audit feedback throughout.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The bounded helpdesk map makes role-scoped retrieval and file-host-only screenshots precede the answer branch. Uncertainty returns to clarification, and ticket creation crosses explicit confirmation and field validation before producing a ticket and audit receipt.

Palettes, reading paths, geometry and annotation patterns are visibly distinct.
